Class DisplayMapController

java.lang.Object
controller.DisplayMapController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DisplayMapController extends Object implements Serializable
The DisplayMapController class serves as a manager for handling operations related to maps and cities stored in the MapRepository and CityRepository. It provides methods to retrieve lists of maps and cities, validate the existence of maps by their name, and ensure the initialization of required repositories.
